Appearance:
She has brown-black hair which varies in length and style between games (tending towards long and loose in later works), and her eyes vary from brown to red to even blue depending on the game, but she still wears a red ribbon and matching tubes on her sidelocks. She's still seen in her "shrine maiden uniform", but it now bears little in common with the standard uniform beyond the red-and-white colour scheme (which ZUN has acknowledged). This uniform consists of a red skirt (rather than the standard hakama), a sleeveless red top with a white collar, tied with a ribbon whose color varies across games, and a pair of white detached sleeves which exposes her sarashi. Due to the color scheme, she's occasionally called the "red-white shrine maiden". Her shaman clothing and her purification rod came from Rinnosuke Morichika, but it's unknown who designs them.

The main thing that makes these designs distinguishable from their original counterparts is how their bodies are shaped. Reimu in this instance now has a more curvaceous body; her breasts and ass being some of more notable things her body has to offer since they're pretty large and are accentuated by her clothes often appearing tight on her.

Personality:
Reimu is the main character of the Touhou Project series.
Reimu’s personality seems to be based on her desires, such as being wanted, having good food, and finding happiness. But usually doesn’t acknowledge her internal conflicts. Reimu is usually seen as a joyful and somewhat mindless person but can quickly be changed if her routine is changed. Her ability is to float, and has a variety of powers (being the Hakurei Shrine Maiden).
Reimu's all about donations, seeing as people usually don't often donate to her other than to satisfy their own pleasures. So long as you've donated enough money to satisfy her and her shrine, she'll be at your service. Donate to her at your own discretion!

Additional Information:
● She is quick to anger, but she’s also quick to forget.

● Reimu uses the Yin-Yang Orbs in combat. They also functioned as communicators with people above the surface. In addition, she usually carries a gohei, sometimes referred to as her purification rod.
She also possesses a great amount of ofuda, which are sacred paper charms with anti-youkai properties that she uses to fight, seal or exterminate youkai of any kind in her danmaku. Apparently, she can also use them to create barriers and even clones of herself. 
She either uses the ofuda as a normal shot (usually with homing properties) or as bullets for her spell cards. Aside from this, the other projectile she uses is a large collection of throwing needles hidden within her sleeves.

● One of Reimu’s most powerful spell cards is "Innate Dream". Upon casting, seven Yin-Yang orbs appear. One lights every time you land a melee hit; when all are lit, a large-scale attack envelops the whole field.

● She has trouble of taking care of herself. As she almost died due to food poisoning. This was seen in Wild and Horned Hermit chapter 46.

● Reimu is stated to be left-handed.

● Reimu has one of the most broken abilities, the ability to float. Her floating ability is immensely broken, as she’s excels at floating through life. While she "goes with the flow" 
Reimu displays superhuman instincts and incredible luck, naturally ending up on the path of least resistance through most situations; conversely, when distracted or acting with impure motives she quickly loses her edge.
Observers even saw her dodging an attack "like she was made of air" while Reimu herself saw the attack swerving to avoid her; another time her powers went to use was when Reimu unknowingly walked across a river without getting wet, by stepping on fish that swam beneath her feet.
Even Marisa Kirisame has trouble learning how she uses this ability, since even Reimu herself has trouble explaining what she's doing. 
The ultimate expression of this ability is Dream-like Nature, which allows Reimu to float away from reality and become impossible to attack; this was considered too powerful for use as a spell card until Marisa gave it a name and time limit.
